title: V10 Anthracite

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The HJC V10 Anthracite is optimized for upright naked and roadster riders seeking wide-angle road awareness, delivering responsive balance and confident road feel. Featuring a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) architecture at 1463g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~86 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Classic look with new-age performance and safety.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; may feel tight on very round heads.

technical_analysis: Features Premium Integrated Matrix (P.I.M. Plus) carbon and carbon-glass hybrid fabric shell structure paired with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism. The interior utilizes ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the HJC V10 Anthracite: combining South Korea 🇰🇷 craftsmanship with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism and ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: HJC V10 Anthracite: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the HJC V10 Anthracite. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in

qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The HJC V10 Anthracite is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.

ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.

introduction: Positioned in HJC's Full Face lineup, the V10 Anthracite brings South Korean engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The HJC V10 Anthracite represents HJC's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the HJC V10 Anthracite delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
